name: heat_slab
description: solve_heat on the instance mesh of every region of split_rect (a, b): dirichlet T1 on hot (x = 0), robin (h, T_ext) on cold (x = L), zero on the remaining attributes (the unnamed top and bottom); the slab T = T1 - q x / k, q = (T1 - T_ext) / (L/k + 1/h), is linear and exact in the P2 space
mesh: the mesher's unstructured mesh of the document (gmsh, bounded planar mode, algorithm and options of axmp-mesher), mesh.size = H/8, region a H/16, geometry order 2 (the default: straight edges, with nodes); one process

T.what: max |T - T_slab| / (T1 - T_ext) at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element

heat_flux_field.what: max |-k grad T - q e_x| / q at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element

Q_cold.what: |Q(cold) - q H| / (q H), the heat flux -k grad T . n through cold by the instrument (face_points, order 4)

Q_interface.what: |Q(interface) - q H| / (q H), through the section interface (+e_x, from a to b)

unrecorded_platforms: the lr7 nodes of feature rocky8 (n0150 to n0153), a second processor model of the lr7 partition
any other partition the gate is pointed at

document.name: split_rect
document.description: a rectangle L x H split at x = L/2 into the regions a and b; a marker across a at x = L/4, written bottom to top; a third region c, disabled; top and bottom left unnamed
